reuse.why: Reuses getTemplatedCategoryIds, getSheetValue and setBudget, but copies setZero's category query and income/template filter instead of extracting a shared month-wide selection for the existing actions and the new one.

duplication.why: The category SQL, the income-in-tracking and templated exclusions, and the expense sign flip are copied from setZero/set3MonthAvg, adding a sixth copy of the selection.

placement.why: The action sits in budget/actions.ts next to its siblings and is registered in budget/app.ts, as the tree does for month-wide actions.

scope.why: Only the new action and its registration are added.

maintainability.why: Which categories month-wide actions fill is now defined in yet another place, so any future rule change (e.g. #fixed groups) must be repeated here too.

bypasses_abstraction.where: No shared month-wide selection exists in this tree to bypass; the existing getTemplatedCategoryIds helper is used.

disguised_duplication.where: The copied selection is a near-verbatim copy of setZero's query and filter, not reshaped.
